title: Lexicon
description: Stems and the properties that cannot be derived from their spelling.

final_voicing.description: Stem-final p/c/t/k voices before a vowel-initial suffix. Required on any stem ending in one of those four; see the semantic checks.

vowel_deletion.description: The last stem vowel drops before a vowel-initial suffix: burun -> burnu.

predicate_natural.description: For pos: noun only. True if a learner would plausibly hear this word predicated onto a person ("biz doktoruz", we are doctors): a role, profession, kinship term, or the like, not a concrete object ("biz masayiz", we are a table). Read by the predicative unit's exercises via lexeme_filter: {predicative_only: true}; adjectives never need this, since almost any adjective is a natural personal predicate.

harmony_class.description: Only on disharmonic loans, where suffix backness does not follow the last stem vowel.

etymology.description: A loan origin and root, or 'modern coinage' plus what it is built from. Optional: absent for any lexeme whose history is not well established rather than guessed. This is prose shown directly to a learner, so it is subject to the same em-dash rule as other learner-facing text.

frequency_band.description: Corpus frequency band. Absent until a real list is loaded; never guessed.

review.description: Anything a native speaker should confirm. Never a placeholder for a guess.
